namespace PubAV10
structure ChanState where
  sent : Nat
  inFlight : Nat
  delivered : Nat
def chanInv (s : ChanState) : Prop := s.sent = s.inFlight + s.delivered
inductive ChanEv | send | ack
def stepChan (s : ChanState) : ChanEv → ChanState
  | .send => ⟨s.sent + 1, s.inFlight + 1, s.delivered⟩
  | .ack => if s.inFlight > 0 then ⟨s.sent, s.inFlight - 1, s.delivered + 1⟩ else s
theorem channel_trace_inv (s : ChanState) (evs : List ChanEv) (h : chanInv s) : let s' := evs.foldl stepChan s; chanInv s' ∧ s'.delivered ≤ s'.sent := by sorry
end PubAV10
